location.en: Maple Bay Language Institute, library study room
location.zh: 楓灣語言學院，圖書館自習室

goal.en: Study with friends for tomorrow's grammar exam.
goal.zh: 和朋友一起準備明天的文法考試。

background: library study room at night with a long table, open textbooks, highlighters and coffee cups, a desk lamp glowing warmly, dark windows, quiet cozy atmosphere

intro.en: Tomorrow is the big grammar exam. You, Leo and Yuki meet in the library.
intro.zh: 明天就是重要的文法考試。你、里歐和由紀約在圖書館。

intro.en: I've read this page five times. Nothing is going in.
intro.zh: 這頁我讀了五遍，什麼都沒進腦袋。

choices.en: Not great. I'm stuck on the past tense.
choices.tip: be stuck on... 表示「卡在某個地方」，說明自己哪裡不會，別人才幫得上忙。

choices.en: So-so. The past tense is very trouble.
choices.zh: 普普通通。過去式很麻煩。

lines.en: Very trouble? Is the past tense... in trouble?
lines.zh: 很麻煩？過去式……惹上麻煩了嗎？

story.en: Yuki imagines the past tense being arrested. She can't stop laughing, and the librarian says "Shh!"
story.zh: 由紀想像過去式被警察抓走，笑到停不下來，圖書館員對你們「噓！」了一聲。

fail.why: trouble 是名詞，不能用 very 修飾。要說 The past tense is really hard. 或 I'm stuck on the past tense.。

choices.en: Easy. I didn't study, but I'm fine.
choices.zh: 簡單。我都沒讀，但沒問題啦。

lines.en: You didn't study? Then why are we here at 9 p.m.?
lines.zh: 你沒讀？那我們晚上九點在這裡幹嘛？

story.en: Yuki stops sharing her notes with you. After all, you don't need them, right?
story.zh: 由紀不再分你筆記了。畢竟你說你不需要嘛，對吧？

fail.why: 台灣學生常說「我都沒讀」來降低期待，但在國外，這聽起來像在炫耀或說謊。誠實說出卡在哪裡：I'm stuck on the past tense.。

lines.en: Leo takes really good notes. Maybe they can help?
lines.zh: 里歐的筆記做得很好，也許能幫上忙？

choices.en: Leo, could I borrow your notes?
choices.zh: 里歐，可以借我看你的筆記嗎？
choices.tip: Could I borrow...? 是禮貌借東西的說法。borrow 是借入，主詞是 I。

choices.en: Leo, give me your notes, OK?

lines.en: Give you? Wow. What's the magic word?
lines.zh: 給你？哇。神奇的那個字呢？

story.en: Leo hugs his notebook and makes you say "please" three times. Yuki enjoys the show.
story.zh: 里歐抱緊筆記本，要你說三次「please」。由紀在旁邊看得很開心。

fail.why: give me... 是命令句，加 OK? 也不會變客氣。借東西要用 Could I borrow your notes? 或 Could you lend me your notes?。

choices.en: Leo, your notes can lend me see?
choices.zh: 里歐，你的筆記可以借我看嗎？

lines.en: My notes can... see? Do they have eyes now?
lines.zh: 我的筆記可以……看？它們長眼睛了嗎？

story.en: Leo draws two eyes on the cover of his notebook. It's cute, but you still can't read it.
story.zh: 里歐在筆記本封面畫上兩顆眼睛。很可愛，但你還是沒借到。

fail.why: 「筆記可以借我看嗎」逐字翻譯，主詞變成筆記，句子就亂了。要說 Could I borrow your notes?。

lines.en: Sure, here. But honestly, reading notes is so boring.
lines.zh: 好啊，拿去。不過說真的，讀筆記好無聊。

choices.en: Then let's quiz each other instead.
choices.zh: 那我們改成互相考考看吧。
choices.tip: quiz 可以當動詞「小考、考問」。each other 是「彼此」，quiz each other 就是互相出題。

choices.en: Then we test us each other.

lines.en: Test us... each other... who tests who?
lines.zh: 測我們……彼此……到底誰考誰？

story.en: Your team spends fifteen minutes deciding who asks first. Nobody asks any questions.
story.zh: 你們花了十五分鐘決定誰先出題。結果一題都沒考。

fail.why: each other 本身就是受詞，前面不用再加 us。提議一起做事用 let's：Let's quiz each other.。

choices.en: Yes, your notes are really boring.
choices.zh: 對啊，你的筆記真的很無聊。

lines.en: Hey! I said reading notes is boring, not my notes!
lines.zh: 喂！我是說讀筆記很無聊，不是我的筆記無聊！

story.en: Leo takes his notebook back. You spend the night with your own notes, which are mostly drawings.
story.zh: 里歐把筆記本收回去了。你只能整晚看自己的筆記，上面大多是塗鴉。

fail.why: 里歐說的是「讀筆記這件事」很無聊，不是他的筆記無聊。聽錯重點會傷到人。這時可以提出更好的讀書方法：Then let's quiz each other.。

lines.en: An hour later, you answer every question right.
lines.zh: 一個小時後，你每一題都答對了。

lines.en: Wow, Kai! You're really good at this now!
lines.zh: 哇，凱！你現在真的很厲害耶！

choices.en: Thanks! You two helped a lot.
choices.zh: 謝謝！你們兩個幫了很多忙。
choices.tip: 被稱讚時說 Thanks! 大方接受，再把功勞分給別人，是最自然的回應。

choices.en: No, no. I'm still very bad. I will fail.
choices.zh: 沒有啦，我還是很爛，一定會考不好。

lines.en: But... you got every answer right. Are you OK?
lines.zh: 可是……你每一題都答對了耶。你還好嗎？

story.en: Leo and Yuki spend the rest of the night trying to boost your confidence. Nobody studies any more grammar.
story.zh: 里歐和由紀整晚都在幫你建立自信。之後大家都沒再讀文法了。

fail.why: 台灣人被稱讚時習慣說「沒有啦」，但英文直接否定會讓對方尷尬。大方接受讚美：Thanks! You two helped a lot.。

choices.en: Yes! Thank you for help me.

lines.en: "For help me"? Hmm, maybe one more hour of grammar?
lines.zh: 「For help me」？嗯，要不要再多讀一小時文法？

story.en: Leo opens the grammar book again. You study until the library closes at midnight.
story.zh: 里歐又把文法書打開。你們一路讀到圖書館午夜關門。

fail.why: 介系詞 for 後面接名詞或 V-ing：Thank you for helping me.。也可以說 Thanks! You two helped a lot.。

story.en: You walk home under the stars, repeating the past tense in your head. For the first time, the exam doesn't feel scary.
story.zh: 你在星空下走回家，腦中複習著過去式。第一次覺得考試沒那麼可怕。

notes.explain: 向同學借東西的禮貌說法。Could 比 Can 更客氣。也可以說 Could you lend me your notes?。

example.en: Could I borrow your charger for a minute?
example.zh: 可以借一下你的充電器嗎？

notes.explain: quiz 可當動詞，quiz each other 是互相出題。each other 是受詞，前面不加 us。

example.en: Let's quiz each other on these new words.
example.zh: 我們來互考這些新單字吧。

notes.explain: be stuck on 表示被某個問題卡住。具體說出哪裡卡住，別人才知道怎麼幫你。

example.en: I'm stuck on question five. Can you help?
example.zh: 我卡在第五題，可以幫我嗎？

notes.explain: trouble 是名詞，不能用 very 修飾。可以說 It's a lot of trouble.、It's really hard. 或 It's a pain.。
台灣人習慣用「沒有啦」或「我都沒讀」表示謙虛，但英語文化中直接否定稱讚會讓人尷尬。說 Thanks! 再分享功勞最自然。

example.en: Thanks! I had a great teacher.
example.zh: 謝謝！我遇到很好的老師。
